frames.narration: Alice opens the app on her phone. It connects to a gateway and sends a heartbeat that names her user, her device and the gateway. Heartbeats come every 10 seconds from now on.
The presence service writes a session key with a 30 second TTL, three heartbeat intervals. This is her first live session, so her status changes from offline to online.
Only the change is published, not the heartbeats. The fan-out workers look up Alice's 200 friends, find the 20 who are online and have her on screen, and send the change to those 20 only.

Alice opens a chat with Bob and starts typing. The typing event goes through the gateway straight to Bob's connection. Nothing is stored, and Bob's app hides the indicator after 5 seconds unless it is refreshed.
Alice also opens her laptop. It sends its own heartbeat and gets a second session key. She already counts as online, so nothing is published and no friend receives a message.
Her phone goes into a tunnel and two heartbeats are lost. The key was renewed 20 seconds ago and the TTL is 30, so it is still alive and nobody sees a flicker.

The phone never comes back. Its key expires after 30 seconds without a renewal, so the presence service drops that session. The laptop session is still alive, so Alice stays online and again nothing is published.

Later she shuts the laptop. Its key expires too, and this was her last session. Alice goes offline, the change is published, and the fan-out workers tell the friends who are watching, with a last seen time.
